physical_conditions.enclosure_and_internal_wiring: Do not open, reseat boards, unplug electrodes or move internal wiring
physical_conditions.operator: Same operator, same plant contact point and similar contact pressure/posture in each repetition
physical_conditions.electrodes: Use unequivocal external red/black labels; red clips remain in their original position
physical_conditions.initial_ground_state: All black measurement tips free of soil, plants and people
physical_conditions.public: Closed for maintenance, confirmed by user
physical_conditions.exceptions: Unexpected touch, moving a cable, hidden timer, missed cue, clock/network issue or environmental change must be recorded; do not silently keep the affected trial as clean

observation.ED5_limit: Currently reports firmware 1.0, without detailed PLANTDIAG stream or OTA firmware version independently verified for this session. CKv2 and raw MIDI channel 8 are available; do not claim ADC data for ED5
observation.MIDI: Read-only additional input on loopMIDI Port 2, channels 6-10; never create a MIDI output
observation.audio: Operator report; MIDI is not proof of actual audio playback
observation.ADC: Unipolar codes or nominal code-derived scales, not calibrated signed analogue voltage. Metrics depend on existing firmware; compare within-node before and during each condition
observation.connections: Resolved current CKv2 IPs before capture, not historical DHCP addresses
observation.timestamps: UTC host capture timestamps, node t_ms when available; experiment controller also records host monotonic clock and scheduled/displayed cue timestamps
observation.raw_waveform_limit: Existing PLANTDIAG contains summaries and selected readings, not a complete waveform from every acquisition. Unified deeper telemetry, if needed, is a separate OTA version with matching processing and exact rollback
observation.sensor_metric_semantics: telemetry_schema.json: for EB5/EC5 pilot, filt is RMS and rms_mean is arithmetic ADC mean. Never compare rms_mean directly to base/threshold as if it were RMS.

stages.name: Untouched reference
stages.condition: Glass on, all black tips free, no touching
stages.initial_excluded_recording: captura_1700Z has data for only 3 detailed nodes because EB5 changed DHCP address; preserve it but do not use it as the complete five-node reference

stages.name: Characterize contacts node by node

condition_meaning.own_pair: One hand on target plant, other hand on its marked black electrode
condition_meaning.plant_only: One hand on target plant; no contact with any black
condition_meaning.black_only: One hand on marked black; no plant contact
condition_meaning.cross_pair: One hand on target plant, other hand on a different node's marked black
condition_meaning.sham: Approach plant without touching; optional movement control

stages.black_matrix_extension: If response depends on which black is used, extend the affected targets across all five black electrodes. Initial cyclic comparison is not an exhaustive 5x5 matrix
stages.contact_cue: The controller publishes the actual condition, contact order and exact action for every phase, not a generic TOCA instruction.
stages.report: After all three repetitions, record cue compliance, actual repetition count, audibility count, held-note variation/release behavior and incidents
stages.separation_of_contact_and_sound: Physical condition is labelled independently of firmware activation and whether sound was heard
stages.baseline_recheck: Two-minute untouched reference between node blocks; compare to initial reference before interpreting slow changes
stages.order_control: Compare two separate trials: black first then add plant without releasing black; plant first then add black without releasing plant. Keep rest and release-to-no-contact unchanged. Counterbalance which order is first between node blocks and validate again in reverse trial order.
stages.explicit_rest: Both hands free. No hand touches any plant or any black tip, including the preparatory phase.
stages.explicit_release: Paired trials: release both plant and black. Plant-only trials: release plant, both hands free. Black-only trials: release black, both hands free. No condition holds black throughout rest.

baseline_recheck_implementation.contact_labels: Unchanged; reference precedes the first 20-second repetition rest.

cross_selection_adjustment.reason: Reciprocal pair with EB5 preserves known seated access for both plants; keep first EC5 cross comparable to completed EB5/EC5 cross. Other black electrodes can be tested later under explicitly recorded access/posture conditions.

stages.name: One black in soil and shared-reference effects
stages.eligibility: Only if external black tip can be placed without removing glass or disturbing internal wiring
stages.ground_location: Record which black and exact external soil/contact point; electronic GND must not be equated with protective earth
sequence: Leave one black fixed, other four free, allow two minutes to settle
Repeat selected plant-only and paired-contact conditions
Return black to original free state, settle and repeat reference
stages.scope: Observe all five nodes; compare within-node before, during and after. Do not assume physically identical effects from shared schematic GND
stages.confirmed_posture: All four plants standing with shoes, requested by operator
stages.contact_order: EB5 plant alone; EC5/EE5/EF5 plant-only 20 seconds then own black added without releasing plant for 20 seconds

stages.name: Firmware design and independent validation
stages.design: Use distinguishable features demonstrated in recordings: amplitude/occupancy or energy change relative to local rest, persistence, edge/release and shared-node changes. Learn baseline/noise continuously only in reliable rest; freeze during suspected contact; use hysteresis and time evidence. Keep physical ADC limitations explicit

role.EB5_EC5_EE5_EF5: Silent in rest, sustained changing notes during supported contact modes and release to silence
role.ED5: Continuous musical base with bounded variation; contact modulates base rather than silencing it

stages.deployment: Preserve exact installed binaries/settings for rollback, version all changes, deploy on OTA-confirmed nodes in stages. Do not modify Ableton or change other boxes
stages.evaluation: Use repetitions/time blocks held out from calibration, short visitor-like contacts and long untouched periods. Record missed contacts, unintended activations, retention/release behavior and effects on untouched nodes
stages.cross_day_claim: Today's success cannot establish daily robustness; repeat a fixed subset on later days and at different times before declaring the firmware validated across those conditions

analysis_windows.rest: Use the last 15 s of each 20 s rest, preserving the earlier 5 s for settling checks
analysis_windows.stable_contact: Scheduled contact seconds 3-18, only when operator confirms following cues; keep edges separately
analysis_windows.release: Analyze immediate release separately and final 15 s as recovered rest
analysis_windows.latency_limit: Server cue and display acknowledgement are measured. Human physical onset is not instrumented; never report precise touch-to-note latency from these scheduled labels
metrics: Within-node change relative to neighboring rest
MIDI NoteOn/NoteOff rate, pitch/range and open notes
analysis_windows.first_contact_only: Preserve the 10 s first-contact phase separately from the combined-contact phase; assess settled seconds 3-8 and preserve transitions with onset uncertainty.

operator_environment.ground_claim: Record physical posture/material/moisture only. Clothing or footwear do not prove conductive grounding or complete electrical isolation.
operator_environment.current_constraints: EB5 and EC5 accessible seated or standing; EE5, EF5 and ED5 require standing.
operator_environment.sequence: Finish corrected cross-pair trial seated with same footwear. Complete the comparable EB5/EC5 contact conditions in that posture. Then use a selected identical contact subset within EB5/EC5 while standing; collect untouched rest after posture changes.
operator_environment.control: Keep same operator, plant contact location, contact order, pressure and timings. Change one planned factor per comparison. Alternate or repeat the posture order to check time drift.
operator_environment.footwear_extension: Shoes, socks and barefoot are distinct conditions. Compare only feasible volunteered conditions; do not assume socks and barefoot equivalent.
operator_environment.weather: Use time-stamped station observations as context with source, location and gaps; forecasts do not confirm rain. Operator reports local floor wetness; never infer it from a distant station alone.
